export const LineComment = createToken({ name: "LineComment", pattern: /\/\/[^\n\r]*/, group: Lexer.SKIPPED });

```ts
export interface LexIssue { message: string; offset?: number }
export interface ParseIssue { message: string; token?: { startOffset?: number } }

export function lexingError(headerName: string, source: string, errors: LexIssue[]): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.offset !== undefined ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.offset)})` : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  throw new Error(`Failed to lex ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
}

export function parsingError(headerName: string, source: string, errors: ParseIssue[]): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.token?.startOffset !== undefined ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.token.startOffset)})` : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  const error = new Error(`Failed to parse ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
  Object.assign(error, { token: (errors[0] as { token?: unknown })?.token });
  throw error;
}
```

// Scaffolding shared between the ofx header parsers
// (`parser-ofxPropsMetadata` and `parser-ofxPropsBySet`), moved here per the
// instructions in each parser's `impl-by-llms/INSTRUCTIONS.md` (point 6).
// Everything here is dialect-agnostic: trivia tokens that carry no token
// categories, preprocessor tokens shared by the headers, and small helpers.

import { createToken, Lexer } from "chevrotain";
import type { TokenType } from "chevrotain";

// --- skipped by the lexer -----------------------------------------------------

export const WhiteSpace = createToken({
  name: "WhiteSpace",
  pattern: /\s+/,
  group: Lexer.SKIPPED,
});
export const LineComment = createToken({
  name: "LineComment",
  pattern: /\/\/[^\n\r]*/,
  group: Lexer.SKIPPED,
});
export const BlockComment = createToken({
  name: "BlockComment",
  pattern: /\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//,
  group: Lexer.SKIPPED,
});

// --- preprocessor --------------------------------------------------------------

export const PragmaOnce = createToken({
  name: "PragmaOnce",
  pattern: /#pragma[ \t]+once\b/,
});
export const Include = createToken({ name: "Include", pattern: Lexer.NA });
export const IncludeAngle = createToken({
  name: "IncludeAngle",
  pattern: /#include[ \t]*<[^>\n\r]*>/,
  categories: [Include],
});
export const IncludeQuoted = createToken({
  name: "IncludeQuoted",
  pattern: /#include[ \t]*"[^"\n\r]*"/,
  categories: [Include],
});

/** Trivia + preprocessor tokens shared by every header dialect, in lexer order. */
export const headerBaseTokens = [
  WhiteSpace,
  LineComment,
  BlockComment,
  PragmaOnce,
  IncludeAngle,
  IncludeQuoted,
] as const;

/** A lexer for a header dialect: shared trivia/preprocessor tokens first, then the dialect's own. */
export function makeHeaderLexer(dialectTokens: TokenType[]): Lexer {
  return new Lexer([...headerBaseTokens, ...dialectTokens], {
    positionTracking: "onlyOffset",
  });
}

// --- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Maps a token offset in the source to a 1-based line number. */
export function lineOf(source: string, offset: number): number {
  let line = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < offset && i < source.length; i++) {
    if (source.charCodeAt(i) === 10) line++;
  }
  return line;
}

/** Throws the given message; used to fail from inside parser ACTIONs. */
export function fail(message: string): never {
  throw new Error(message);
}

/**
 * Parses the simple string literals used by the headers. They contain plain
 * quoted identifiers only; anything fancier is a structural change and is
 * rejected.
 */
export function parseCppString(image: string): string {
  if (
    image.length < 2 || image[0] !== "\"" || image[image.length - 1] !== "\"" ||
    image.slice(1, -1).includes("\"") || image.slice(1, -1).includes("\\")
  ) {
    fail(`unsupported string literal: ${image}`);
  }
  return image.slice(1, -1);
}

/** Parses a non-negative decimal integer token image. */
export function toInt(image: string, what: string): number {
  const value = Number(image);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) {
    fail(`invalid ${what}: ${image}`);
  }
  return value;
}

// --- error formatting --------------------------------------------------------------

/** Minimal structural types satisfied by chevrotain's error objects. */
export interface LexIssue {
  message: string;
  offset?: number;
}
export interface ParseIssue {
  message: string;
  token?: { startOffset?: number };
}

/** Collects lexer errors into a single thrown Error (never returns). */
export function lexingError(
  headerName: string,
  source: string,
  errors: LexIssue[],
): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.offset !== undefined
      ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.offset)})`
      : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  throw new Error(`Failed to lex ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
}

/** Collects parser errors into a single thrown Error (never returns). */
export function parsingError(
  headerName: string,
  source: string,
  errors: ParseIssue[],
): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.token?.startOffset !== undefined
      ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.token.startOffset)})`
      : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  const error = new Error(`Failed to parse ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
  // Attach the first offending token for programmatic inspection.
  Object.assign(error, { token: errors[0]?.token });
  throw error;
}
```

// INSTRUCTIONS.md, point 6). Everything here is dialect-agnostic: trivia
// tokens that carry no token categories, preprocessor tokens, and small
// helpers used by both implementations.

import { createToken, Lexer } from "chevrotain";
import type { ILexingError, IRecognitionException, TokenType } from "chevrotain";

export const WhiteSpace = createToken({ name: "WhiteSpace", pattern: /\s+/, group: Lexer.SKIPPED });
export const LineComment = createToken({ name: "LineComment", pattern: /\/\/[^\n\r]*/, group: Lexer.SKIPPED });
export const BlockComment = createToken({ name: "BlockComment", pattern: /\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//, group: Lexer.SKIPPED });

export const PragmaOnce = createToken({ name: "PragmaOnce", pattern: /#pragma[ \t]+once\b/ });
export const Include = createToken({ name: "Include", pattern: Lexer.NA });
export const IncludeAngle = createToken({ name: "IncludeAngle", pattern: /#include[ \t]*<[^>\n\r]*>/, categories: [Include] });
export const IncludeQuoted = createToken({ name: "IncludeQuoted", pattern: /#include[ \t]*"[^"\n\r]*"/, categories: [Include] });

/** Trivia + preprocessor tokens shared by every header dialect, in lexer order. */
export const headerBaseTokens = [WhiteSpace, LineComment, BlockComment, PragmaOnce, IncludeAngle, IncludeQuoted];

export function makeHeaderLexer(dialectTokens: TokenType[]): Lexer {
  return new Lexer([...headerBaseTokens, ...dialectTokens], { positionTracking: "onlyOffset" });
}

export function fail(message: string): never { throw new Error(message); }

export function lineOf(source: string, offset: number): number { ... }

export function parseCppString(image: string): string { ... }

export function toInt(image: string, what: string): number { ... }

export function lexError(headerName: string, source: string, errors: ILexingError[]): never { ... }
export function parseError(headerName: string, source: string, errors: IRecognitionException[]): never { ... }

```ts
export interface LexIssue { message: string; offset?: number }
export interface ParseIssue { message: string; token?: { startOffset?: number } }

export function lexingError(headerName: string, source: string, errors: LexIssue[]): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.offset !== undefined ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.offset)})` : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  throw new Error(`Failed to lex ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
}

export function parsingError(headerName: string, source: string, errors: ParseIssue[]): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.token?.startOffset !== undefined ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.token.startOffset)})` : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  const error = new Error(`Failed to parse ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
  Object.assign(error, { token: (errors[0] as { token?: unknown })?.token });
  throw error;
}
```

import { createToken, CstParser, EOF, Lexer } from "chevrotain";
import {
  BlockComment,
  Include,
  IncludeAngle,
  IncludeQuoted,
  LineComment,
  PragmaOnce,
  WhiteSpace,
  fail,
  headerBaseTokens,
  lexingError,
  makeHeaderLexer,

import type { FinalResult, Result, Structure } from "../types.ts";

const HEADER_NAME = "ofxPropsBySet.h";

// --- token categories -------------------------------------------------------
// Struct bodies (struct Prop) are consumed as bracket-delimited "soup": any
// token that legitimately appears inside them is a member of AnyExceptBrace;
// tokens that would indicate a structural surprise (namespace, static, true,
// string literals, numbers, ...) are not, so their appearance there is a
// parse error.

const AnyExceptBrace = createToken({ name: "AnyExceptBrace", pattern: Lexer.NA });
const soupBrace = [AnyExceptBrace];

// --- keywords ---------------------------------------------------------------

const StaticAssertKW = createToken({ name: "StaticAssertKW", pattern: /static_assert\b/ });
const NamespaceKW = createToken({ name: "NamespaceKW", pattern: /namespace\b/ });
const StructKW = createToken({ name: "StructKW", pattern: /struct\b/ });
const StaticKW = createToken({ name: "StaticKW", pattern: /static\b/ });
const InlineKW = createToken({ name: "InlineKW", pattern: /inline\b/ });
const ConstKW = createToken({ name: "ConstKW", pattern: /const\b/, categories: soupBrace });
const CharKW = createToken({ name: "CharKW", pattern: /char\b/, categories: soupBrace });
const BoolKW = createToken({ name: "BoolKW", pattern: /bool\b/, categories: soupBrace });

// --- fixed multi-word symbols ------------------------------------------------

const StdMap = createToken({ name: "StdMap", pattern: /std::map\b/ });
const StdVector = createToken({ name: "StdVector", pattern: /std::vector\b/ });
const StdArray = createToken({ name: "StdArray", pattern: /std::array\b/ });
const StdStringView = createToken({ name: "StdStringView", pattern: /std::string_view\b/ });
const OpenfxNS = createToken({ name: "OpenfxNS", pattern: /openfx\b/ });
const PropKW = createToken({ name: "PropKW", pattern: /Prop\b/, categories: soupBrace });
const PropIdKW = createToken({ name: "PropIdKW", pattern: /PropId\b/ });
const PropDefsVar = createToken({ name: "PropDefsVar", pattern: /prop_defs\b/ });
const PropSetsVar = createToken({ name: "PropSetsVar", pattern: /prop_sets\b/ });
const ActionsVar = createToken({ name: "ActionsVar", pattern: /actions\b/ });
const ActionPropsVar = createToken({ name: "ActionPropsVar", pattern: /action_props\b/ });

// --- punctuation and literals ------------------------------------------------

const LBrace = createToken({ name: "LBrace", pattern: /\{/ });
const RBrace = createToken({ name: "RBrace", pattern: /\}/ });
const LParen = createToken({ name: "LParen", pattern: /\(/, categories: soupBrace });
const RParen = createToken({ name: "RParen", pattern: /\)/, categories: soupBrace });
const LBracket = createToken({ name: "LBracket", pattern: /\[/ });
const RBracket = createToken({ name: "RBracket", pattern: /\]/ });
const Less = createToken({ name: "Less", pattern: /</ });
const Greater = createToken({ name: "Greater", pattern: />/ });
const Comma = createToken({ name: "Comma", pattern: /,/, categories: soupBrace });
const Colon = createToken({ name: "Colon", pattern: /:/, categories: soupBrace });
const ScopeRes = createToken({ name: "ScopeRes", pattern: /::/ });
const Star = createToken({ name: "Star", pattern: /\*/, categories: soupBrace });
const Amp = createToken({ name: "Amp", pattern: /&/, categories: soupBrace });
const EqEq = createToken({ name: "EqEq", pattern: /==/ });
const Semicolon = createToken({ name: "Semicolon", pattern: /;/, categories: soupBrace });
const BoolLiteral = createToken({ name: "BoolLiteral", pattern: /(?:true|false)\b/ });
const StringLiteral = createToken({ name: "StringLiteral", pattern: /"(?:[^"\\\n\r]|\\.)*"/ });
const NumberLiteral = createToken({ name: "NumberLiteral", pattern: /\d+/ });
const Identifier = createToken({ name: "Identifier", pattern: /[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/, categories: soupBrace });

  BoolLiteral, StringLiteral, NumberLiteral, Identifier,
];

  ...dialectLexerTokens,

// Scaffolding shared between the ofx header parsers
// (`parser-ofxPropsMetadata` and `parser-ofxPropsBySet`), moved here per the
// instructions in each parser's `impl-by-llms/INSTRUCTIONS.md` (point 6).
// Everything here is dialect-agnostic: trivia tokens that carry no token
// categories, preprocessor tokens shared by the headers, and small helpers.

import { createToken, Lexer } from "chevrotain";
import type { TokenType } from "chevrotain";

// --- skipped by the lexer -----------------------------------------------------

export const WhiteSpace = createToken({
  name: "WhiteSpace",
  pattern: /\s+/,
  group: Lexer.SKIPPED,
});
export const LineComment = createToken({
  name: "LineComment",
  pattern: /\/\/[^\n\r]*/,
  group: Lexer.SKIPPED,
});
export const BlockComment = createToken({
  name: "BlockComment",
  pattern: /\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//,
  group: Lexer.SKIPPED,
});

// --- preprocessor --------------------------------------------------------------

export const PragmaOnce = createToken({
  name: "PragmaOnce",
  pattern: /#pragma[ \t]+once\b/,
});
export const Include = createToken({ name: "Include", pattern: Lexer.NA });
export const IncludeAngle = createToken({
  name: "IncludeAngle",
  pattern: /#include[ \t]*<[^>\n\r]*>/,
  categories: [Include],
});
export const IncludeQuoted = createToken({
  name: "IncludeQuoted",
  pattern: /#include[ \t]*"[^"\n\r]*"/,
  categories: [Include],
});

/** Trivia + preprocessor tokens shared by every header dialect, in lexer order. */
export const headerBaseTokens = [
  WhiteSpace,
  LineComment,
  BlockComment,
  PragmaOnce,
  IncludeAngle,
  IncludeQuoted,
] as const;

/** A lexer for a header dialect: shared trivia/preprocessor tokens first, then the dialect's own. */
export function makeHeaderLexer(dialectTokens: TokenType[]): Lexer {
  return new Lexer([...headerBaseTokens, ...dialectTokens], {
    positionTracking: "onlyOffset",
  });
}

// --- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Maps a token offset in the source to a 1-based line number. */
export function lineOf(source: string, offset: number): number {
  let line = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < offset && i < source.length; i++) {
    if (source.charCodeAt(i) === 10) line++;
  }
  return line;
}

/** Throws the given message; used to fail from inside parser ACTIONs. */
export function fail(message: string): never {
  throw new Error(message);
}

/**
 * Parses the simple string literals used by the headers. They contain plain
 * quoted identifiers only; anything fancier is a structural change and is
 * rejected.
 */
export function parseCppString(image: string): string {
  if (
    image.length < 2 || image[0] !== "\"" || image[image.length - 1] !== "\"" ||
    image.slice(1, -1).includes("\"") || image.slice(1, -1).includes("\\")
  ) {
    fail(`unsupported string literal: ${image}`);
  }
  return image.slice(1, -1);
}

/** Parses a non-negative decimal integer token image. */
export function toInt(image: string, what: string): number {
  const value = Number(image);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) {
    fail(`invalid ${what}: ${image}`);
  }
  return value;
}

// --- error formatting --------------------------------------------------------------

/** Minimal structural types satisfied by chevrotain's error objects. */
export interface LexIssue {
  message: string;
  offset?: number;
}
export interface ParseIssue {
  message: string;
  token?: { startOffset?: number };
}

/** Collects lexer errors into a single thrown Error (never returns). */
export function lexingError(
  headerName: string,
  source: string,
  errors: LexIssue[],
): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.offset !== undefined
      ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.offset)})`
      : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  throw new Error(`Failed to lex ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
}

/** Collects parser errors into a single thrown Error (never returns). */
export function parsingError(
  headerName: string,
  source: string,
  errors: ParseIssue[],
): never {
  const details = errors.map((e) => {
    const where = e.token?.startOffset !== undefined
      ? ` (line ${lineOf(source, e.token.startOffset)})`
      : "";
    return `${e.message}${where}`;
  }).join("\n");
  const error = new Error(`Failed to parse ${headerName}:\n${details}`);
  // Attach the first offending token for programmatic inspection.
  Object.assign(error, { token: errors[0]?.token });
  throw error;
}
